panel.title: How to open a stall
panel.text:
Want a permanent shop in the server? Make your own post in this channel and it becomes your stall.

**1.** Press **Get the template** below and copy it.
**2.** Press **New Post** at the top of this channel. Title it like `[Store] Doppler knives and cheap stickers` or `[Have] Butterfly Fade [Want] Cash`.
**3.** Paste the template, fill it in, and add screenshots with **+**. Make it your own: change the layout, add items, whatever you like.

Discord doesn't let you add pictures by editing a post, so to add or change pictures later, use the **Pictures** button under your stall.

**Edit your post any time** to add, change or sell items. Under your stall you get a **Bump** button that moves it to the top once every 12 hours, and editing your post bumps it too (at most every 6 hours).

**Rules:** one stall per member · only CSFloat and Steam links (anything else gets your post removed) · replies are off, so buyers DM the seller · deleting and reposting, or closing and reopening, can't get you to the top sooner than Bump · stalls with no edits or bumps for 30 days close, and you can reopen yours any time.
